coordinate_and_field_inputs.positive_force_direction: n cross g for positive inner spin

time_profile.description: 1 s linear spin-up, 0.5 s dwell, 1 s linear spin-down

principal_findings: Equal rotational energy does not imply K-Field force cancellation.
A prescribed equal-energy state with unequal inertias has nonzero total angular momentum.
Reaction-only spin-up from rest enforces equal and opposite angular momentum, not equal energy.
At fixed transferred angular momentum, the reaction-constrained residual depends on beta*r^2 and not on rotor mass.
The worked equal-energy residual is 2.888765916077209e-03 N.
The worked reaction-only residual is 7.545251040720908e-03 N.
